title: ontoserver-extras
description: Optional infrastructure components for Ontoserver (Varnish cache, OTel Collector, PV)

global.description: Global values passed by umbrella charts. Accepted but not used by this chart.

backendServiceName.description: Override the Kubernetes service name Varnish proxies to. Defaults to RELEASE-ontoserver-service (the ontoserver chart's service). Only needed when the extras chart and ontoserver chart have different release names.

closureBackend.description: Kubernetes hostname for the $closure operation backend. The $closure FHIR operation is stateful — set to a stable pod hostname (e.g. RELEASE-statefulset-0.RELEASE-ontoserver-headless) for scaled deployments. Empty string disables dedicated $closure routing.

enabled.description: Enable the Prometheus metrics exporter sidecar container

scrapeTimeout.description: Prometheus scrape timeout — must be less than interval (e.g. 55s)

enabled.description: Enable VCL with tracing spans and sidecar containers (true) or plain caching VCL (false)

collectorEndpoint.description: Zipkin collector endpoint for trace forwarding (e.g. http://RELEASE-collector:9411). Required when opentelemetry is enabled.

graceSeconds.description: Seconds to serve stale cached content when the backend is unavailable

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level securityContext for the Varnish pod, passed through as-is. Empty means unset.

containerSecurityContext.description: Container-level securityContext applied to every container in the Varnish pod, passed through as-is. Empty means unset.

automountServiceAccountToken.description: Mount the ServiceAccount token into the Varnish pod. Null leaves it to the cluster default.

probes.description: Readiness and liveness probes for the varnish container. tcpSocket on the http port.

enabled.description: Add readiness and liveness probes to the varnish container

traceForwarderImage.description: Trace forwarder container image. Must include curl and sh. Only used when varnish.opentelemetry.enabled is true.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for Varnish containers

varnish.description: Resources for the main Varnish container

exporter.description: Resources for the Prometheus exporter sidecar

traceConverter.description: Resources for the trace converter sidecar (only used when opentelemetry is enabled)

traceForwarder.description: Resources for the trace forwarder sidecar (only used when opentelemetry is enabled)

tolerations.description: Pod tolerations for the Varnish deployment

time200.description: Cache TTL for HTTP 200 responses (Varnish duration syntax, e.g. 10m, 1h, 30s)

time404.description: Cache TTL for HTTP 404 responses (Varnish duration syntax)

timeExpand.description: Cache TTL for $expand responses. Defaults to time200 if empty.

passAuthHeaderRequests.description: When true, requests with an Authorization header bypass the cache (pass). When false, authorized requests are cached like any other.

memorySize.description: Varnish malloc storage pool size passed to -s malloc,<size> (e.g. 800m, 1g, 2g). Should be less than resources.varnish.limits.memory.

otlpEndpoint.description: OTLP gRPC endpoint for trace export (e.g. tempo:4317). Optional — omit if using zipkinEndpoint only.

zipkinEndpoint.description: Zipkin endpoint for trace export (e.g. http://tempo:9411). Optional — omit if using otlpEndpoint only.

debug.description: Enable debug exporter with detailed verbosity. Not suitable for production.

batch.description: Batch processor settings for the traces pipeline

sendBatchSize.description: Spans per batch before the processor flushes

timeout.description: Maximum time a span waits before being flushed regardless of batch size. A zero value is rejected at render time — it disables the flush timer.

varnishProbe.description: Timing for one of the varnish container's tcpSocket probes
